title: Mandatory Disclosure Schema
description: A specific piece of information that a requirement or obligation calls for an organization to make public, such as a Competent Person statement in a valuation, or the kinds of decisions made by automated means in a privacy policy. Each disclosure traces to the obligation or requirement behind it, the data it draws on, and the stakeholder accountable for it.

mandatoryDisclosureID.description: Unique identifier for the disclosure, e.g. DISC-001

description.description: What must be disclosed, in source-describing language

obligationIDs.description: Obligations (semantic library) that call for the disclosure

complianceRequirementIDs.description: Compliance requirements that call for the disclosure

sourceData.description: Records the disclosed information is drawn from

useCaseIDs.description: Standardised AI use cases whose operation the disclosure describes, for AI disclosures

stakeholderTitle.description: Person or role accountable for the disclosure

stakeholderID.description: Stakeholder record for that person or role

publicReportIDs.description: Public reports that contain the disclosure

frequency.description: How often the disclosure is made or refreshed
